rule_evidence.basis_rule: retain relation, intent and exact Evidence/Claim support; drop only witnessed forwarding-Claim basis edges
rule_evidence.host_rule: comparability remains host_derived, separate from deterministic_fixture proposals and updates
rule_evidence.numeric_rule: finite exact Decimal tuple; no tolerance or context rounding
rule_evidence.parameter_rule: empty parameters checked by frozen contract and own-source validation
rule_evidence.raw_record_rule: original record bytes remain immutable; complete uncontracted typed graph retained in audit
rule_evidence.semantic_references: Evidence identities/source/locator retained; runtime IDs only in node identities/edges/audit
rule_evidence.state_rule: preserve visibility and Claim delta; encode actual production-consumption, not independent serial order
rule_evidence.unknown_rule: missing/extra runtime fields, uninterpreted effects or unsupported contraction yield undetermined
